newsitem.title: USA: Gray Communications stake lifted by Gabelli.
newsitem.headline: Gray Communications stake lifted by Gabelli.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Thursday it raised its stake in Gray Communications Systems Inc to 660,634 Class B common shares or 18.88 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 29,234 common Class B shares bought between December 24 and January 6 at prices ranging from $16.1250 to $17.8750 per share.
The group previously held a 17.75 percent in Gray or 621,100 Class B common shares.
Gray, based in Atlanta, Georgia, owns and operates seven network-affiliated television stations in medium-sized markets in the southeastern United States.
